data.text:
Mukesh S/O Liladhar Bhalerao vs The State Of Mah. Thr. Pso Ps
Hudkeshwar ... on 22 August, 2024 
Author: Vinay Joshi
Bench: Vinay Joshi
 1 
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Nagpur Bench : Nagpur
 Criminal Application (Apl) No.299/2023
 (Mukesh S/o Liladhar Bhalerao Vs. The State of Maharash
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 Office Notes, Office Memoranda of Coram, 
 appearances, Court's orders of directions
 and Registrar's orders
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 Mr. Bhushan Dafle, Advocate for the applicant.
 Coram: Vinay Joshi & Mrs.Vrushali V. Joshi, Jj .
Dated: 22.8.2024. 
Heard. 
2.  This is an application seeking to quash F.I.R. in Crime No.0732/2022 registered by non-applicant No.1 for the offence punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273 and 328 of Indian Penal Code, Sections 3(1)(zz)(iv), 26(2)(iv), 27(3)(a), 30(2)(a), 59 and 26(1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. 
3. Issue notice to the non-applicants returnable on 3.10.2024.
4. Mr. Amit Madiwale, learned A.P.P. waives notice for non-applicant No.1/State. 
(MRS.VRUSHALI V.JOSHI, J.) (VINAY JOSHI, J.) Tambaskar.
Signed by: MR. N.V. TAMBASKAR Designation: PA To Honourable Judge Date: 22/08/2024 18:31:04 Mukesh S/O Liladhar Bhalerao vs The State Of Mah. Thr. Pso Ps Hudkeshwar ... on 22 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113095655/
1
